race.comment: READY TIGER (2) loves this track and trip with a win and a placing from just two attempts and gets a stack of weight relief with the 3kg claim. Only needs some luck from the wide draw to be playing a major role in the outcome. ROCK THE SUNRISE (8) has hit the top-five at his past five outings and looks to be working up to another victory. Include in calculations. PREFER TO DANCE (14) has a win and a placing from four starts over this staying journey and will be rock-hard fit for this contest. Top-three credentials. The well-related ECLIPSION (10) (full to Listed winner and G2 placed Far Too Easy) got the job done at Mackay last time out and winning hoop Wiggins stays on top. In the mix. SAVVY THINKER (9) is a last-start winner who shouldn't be slept on.
